## Map

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: center

library(leaflet)

df <- read.csv("~/Documents/ATI_website/Data/mastertemp.csv")

df_subset <- data.frame(
  lng = df$Longitude,
  lat = df$Latitude,
  meanRange = df$meanRange,
  meanAprTemp = df$meanAprTemp,
  site = df$site
)

# Separate palettes for each variable (different scales)
pal_range <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = range(df_subset$meanRange, na.rm = TRUE),
  na.color = "transparent"
)

pal_temp <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "plasma",
  domain = range(df_subset$meanAprTemp, na.rm = TRUE),
  na.color = "transparent"
)

metadata <- paste0(
  "Site ", df_subset$site,
  "<hr>Mean range: ", round(df_subset$meanRange, 2),
  "<hr>Mean temp at April: ", round(df_subset$meanAprTemp, 2), "°C"
)

leaflet(df_subset) %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%
  setView(lng = -149.84, lat = -17.5392, zoom = 12) %>%
  
  # Mean range layer
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    color = ~pal_range(meanRange),
    radius = 4,
    opacity = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = metadata,
    group = "Mean Range"
  ) %>%
  
  # Mean April temp layer
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    color = ~pal_temp(meanAprTemp),
    radius = 4,
    opacity = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = metadata,
    group = "Mean Temp at April"
  ) %>%
  
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Mean Range", "Mean Temp at April"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal_range,
    values = ~meanRange,
    title = "Mean Range",
    opacity = 1
  ) %>%
  
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal = pal_temp,
    values = ~meanAprTemp,
    title = "Mean Temp at April (°C)",
    opacity = 1
  )

```
